blurb: Ole Sawmill Marina offers pontoon boat rentals for full day and half day on the St. Croix River. They also provide seasonal slip rentals for boats up to 50 feet and a vacation house rental with a minimum 2 night stay. The marina has amenities including water and electric at docks, restrooms and showers, free ice for marina members, bonfire pits, picnic tables, and free Wi-Fi.
